acceptanceCriteria: A producer emits corvint-network-evidence/0 per test from a Playwright run or its trace/HAR, with awaited state and timing
A fixture-driven test shows a recorded CDN module dependency reaching the PWP-V0-024 finding end to end
Absent or partial capture still yields UNKNOWN (PWP-V0-027)
body: Residual of V1-1762 (PR #1112, PWP-V0-022..027, GitHub #1106). The external-origins report consumes a closed corvint-network-evidence/0 input, but nothing produces it; today it must be hand-written. Expected: a per-test recorder (page.on request/response with timing and awaited state) or an importer from Playwright HAR/trace files, so real runs yield the report. Actual: NOT_PRODUCED; see the build-log Non-goals in docs/build-log/2026-10-18-V1-1762-external-origins.md.
title: Produce corvint-network-evidence/0 from Playwright runs (per-test request recorder or HAR/trace importer)
